method.inspection: 32 ordinary chained Photonic declarations, target Stage0, 40000 total requested work units split by interval, with a verdict after each call. Both revisions close with 33 states, 528 events and 9281 actual work units. There is no inspection-specific production fast path.
method.runtime: 19 closed exhaustive reference programs; one worker; timing includes initialization, execution, snapshot and release. Existing harness reports minimum, median and maximum rather than individual samples.
